pairs: What It Is

Records every agent run from start to finish, not just in passing — live in production today, not a dormant dashboard. Chat, COS, workflow, and agent-builder runs all feed the same observatory, not separate silos.
Why It Matters

"We can look into it" is a much weaker answer than "here's the exact run, here's what it cost, here's what happened" — this is what makes the second answer possible. This is evidenced, not assumed: real production bug fixes have landed against this pipeline in the last month, which only happens against a system with real traffic.
How It Works
